variableDeclarations.name: current_playbook
variableDeclarations.description: Playbook the agent currently has open.

variableDeclarations.name: current_task
variableDeclarations.description: Task the agent currently has loaded inside the open playbook.

variableDeclarations.name: next_agent_actions
variableDeclarations.description: Reply and actions queued by a tool through set_next_agent_actions, played by the before-model callback without calling the model.

variableDeclarations.name: played_greeting
variableDeclarations.description: Whether the greeting was already sent.

variableDeclarations.name: order_id
variableDeclarations.description: Order number of the order that was last looked up.

variableDeclarations.name: order_status
variableDeclarations.description: Status of the order that was last looked up (Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Canceled, Return Started).

variableDeclarations.name: sms_disclosure_played
variableDeclarations.description: Whether the text message terms were shared with the customer.
